# SSOTMetricDefinition

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A single source of truth (SSOT) for defining the Spatio-Temporal Complexity (CST) metric, ensuring unambiguous, standardized interpretation across TCC and iNEST experiments. It eliminates ambiguity in metric computation, enabling fair comparison and reproducible validation across different chiplet/wafer-scale interconnect designs.
